identityBoundary.rule: Tenant content may use only its own approved identity. A known token from another tenant is a hard failure.

externalReadiness.reason: Internal product integration, device QA and Growth review foundations exist, but public beta scope, cloud data lifecycle, AI quality, aggregate measurement and channel execution acceptance remain open. No current source grants external publishing, sending or paid-spend authority.

reviewNotes: W0/W1/W2/W6 mean prepared contracts, research hypotheses, concept/copy and synthetic learning; they are not deployed agent runtimes.
QA scores in the draft library are self-reported seed metadata. Creative renders, independent artifact-hash-bound review and human approval are still required.
Historical G-A gate labels remain review dependencies, not an assertion that every feature is unimplemented or that all gates have passed.
currentProductState: Tarot has internal Android QA dated 2026-09-29; the 2026-09-30 internal debug-signed APK 0.1.3/code 4 has cold-launch/artwork smoke, not full release acceptance.
Deterministic birth charts and mythology are integrated with internal Android QA dated 2026-09-23. Cloud reports, AI previews, final-build and iOS acceptance remain separate gates.
AI Guides/Council and Journal flows exist; current whole-app review still requires prompt/runtime/grounding quality and cloud save/reopen/edit/delete/export acceptance.
Public beta, production payments, store release, provider workers and campaign optimization have not been certified by this Growth slice.
nextGateOrder: Complete core data lifecycle and AI quality acceptance (GROWTH-01/GROWTH-02).
Prove consent-scoped event persistence, aggregate denominators and a reproducible learning baseline (GROWTH-03).
Produce real creative and independent editorial review while finalizing beta artifact acceptance (GROWTH-04/GROWTH-05).
Review email consent/delivery and one controlled organic adapter before any external activation (GROWTH-06/GROWTH-07).
Consider paid media only after product, entitlement, retention, measurement and budget gates (GROWTH-08).

dataPlane.tenantRuntime: Nilaza private repository and separate backend remain the only permitted data plane.
dataPlane.crossTenantLearning: Only approved aggregate_deidentified LearningExport records may leave a tenant after a future gate.
